evaluation_mode.details: Capture model.training before eval and restore it in a finally block, including when prediction fails.

missing_surface_hd95.details: Frame and patient metrics retain surface status counts and one_absent_count. Paired comparisons report per-patient and total counts; missing counts or a candidate increase make the comparison NO_GO.

physiology_decision.decision: GO when paired V1 mean FG Dice exceeds V1-U, or when paired harm reduction harm_V1U - harm_V1 has a 95% bootstrap CI lower bound greater than 0.0; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.

student_codebook_contract.verification: C0 metadata is checked against the persisted extra state and tensor bytes; old numeric-buffer/getattr assumptions were removed.

student_only_export.resume_schema_policy: resume-v1 is rejected; no weights_only=False fallback exists.
student_only_export.cold_load_import_guard: Fresh subprocess checks forbid Q-3D/A-3D teacher module imports.
student_only_export.codebook_provenance: Frozen C0 version, dimensions, and SHA-256 are carried in artifact metadata.
student_only_export.checkpoint_provenance: Engine exports require the exact source checkpoint SHA-256 and matching .sha256 sidecar.
student_only_export.config_provenance: Manifest records source JSON file SHA-256 separately from the engine's canonical validated-config SHA-256.

profile_artifact_binding.details: A profile report is accepted only for matching artifact bytes. q3d_export reuses that exact artifact when updating its cost manifest, avoiding reserialization byte drift.

external_inference_geometry.details: Inference rejects cropped context and image/shape_zyx mismatches while requiring native spacing and affine fields.

verification.lint_command: rtk ruff check self_audit/candidate_q3d/evaluation.py self_audit/candidate_q3d/export.py scripts/q3d_export.py scripts/q3d_infer.py scripts/q3d_profile.py tests/test_q3d_evaluation_export.py

actual_engine_checkpoint.source: Synthetic CPU engine.train run; actual engine-written resume-v2 latest.pt containing best_student_state and its SHA sidecar.

not_run.real_data_checkpoint_or_weight_hashes: NOT_RUN; no real dataset or pretrained teacher weights were accessed.
not_run.gpu_latency_or_peak_vram: NOT_RUN; no CUDA device is available.

c0_no_u_training_regression.finding: Current joint stage rejects empty image-only U keys unconditionally; this owned export test used one synthetic U patient to produce and verify the actual engine-written checkpoint.
